blocks.title: Cookies
blocks.text: Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke aale par rakhti hain ta ke login aur pasand jaisi cheezein yaad rakhein.
Shopping site par cookies aap ko login rakhti hain, magar dekhe gaye products ka peecha kar ke mutalliqa ishtihar bhi dikha sakti hain, yaani aap ki browsing dekhi ja rahi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Cookies mufeed aur privacy mein dakhal dono kaise ho sakti hain, har ek ki misal ke saath (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Mufeed: shopping site aap ka login aur cart yaad rakhti hai, to har baar sign in nahi karna parta. Dakhal: tracking cookies darj karti hain ke aap kaunse products dekhte hain, shayad kai sites par, ta ke chupke se ishtiharat ke liye profile bane.

items: Cookies: login aur pasand yaad rakhti, magar ishtiharat ke liye browsing ka peecha kar sakti hain.
